name: boat-on-water
comment: WP-2.4b. A 10x10 pool of still water (id 9; x, z in -5..4, y = 58..60, so 3 deep) in a stone block with a rim at y = 61; chunks within 3 preloaded. Three boats (EntityList constructor, ids 0-2) settle on the water from y = 60: the five horizontal slices of the box (EntityBoat.java:133-143) give the buoyancy (:184-193). At t = 20 boat 0 gets set_motion (0.4, 0, 0.3): it crosses the pool (motion clamped to 0.4, friction 0.99, the yaw turning toward the motion at most 20 degrees a tick, splash particles on the boat's own rand while faster than 0.15, :224-244) and hits the east rim on the diagonal: moveEntity zeroes motionX, motionZ stays above 0.15, so it breaks (:246-258: setEntityDead, then 3 planks and 2 sticks). Boat 1 gets set_motion (0, 0, -0.1) and drifts into boat 2: boats are solid to each other (getBoundingBox, :40-42) and the moving one runs Entity.applyEntityCollision on the other (:291-300), both drift on into the rims (isCollidedHorizontally below 0.15: no break). Direct hits of 3 at t = 120 and 121 break boat 1 (30, then 59 > 40: the wood, then setEntityDead, :63-90). The drops sink to the pool floor. rng_state and entity_state every tick.
